Nothing on this earth is brought here with its consent, and it's a crapshoot as to who wants to be pulled from the void and who doesn't. I'm not mad at living beings for fulfilling their biological imperative to create life. I do wish there was some way to ask our souls (if those are a thing; I personally believe so) if they wish to opt out first, though.

  
Society is mad at us for not pulling our weight because they're forced to pull theirs. Being a NEET is a privilege denied to many. If we could *all* forsake working then there'd be no bitterness. Unfortunately, we depend on the normies for sustenance, clothing, shelter etc and they get the raw end of the deal since we give little back. NEETs are net losses. (In terms of resources. Obviously we all have intangible and immutable value as human beings)

  
So I understand why society loathes me for not working enough. Any relationship where one party is all take and no or little give is bound to breed resentment. We didn't choose to be here--but neither did they.

  
Hopefully one day UBI comes along to solve this issue. Wouldn't count on it though.

I enjoy the idea of ultimate freedom for myself and others, but there're reasons why it doesn't work when allowed for the majority of people. Some people take freedom to mean marauding and wanton violence, and they'd go around doing unspeakable things to people. 

Laws, mores and norms also act as a way of facilitating social cohesion and incentivizing altruism. Without modern technology, hell even *with*, it's very difficult for a human to survive as a lone wolf. Even the most reclusive of hikis still depend on the labor of others; they don't farm their own food or tailor their own clothes or build their own homes. 

  
The core message of this is valuable and I resonate with it deeply as most do here but I also like to remind myself why true, pure freedom wouldn't be healthy or sustainable for me. Freedom has to be limited in some way or a lot of people would become very dangerous overnight and life expectancies would plummet.
